about_the_game:
​Demo Content​​

Currently includes ​​Worlds 1-3​​ with complete gameplay (Full version will have at least 6 worlds)

Available systems in Demo:

"Love Magic Base" (HQ management)

Equipment Enhancement

Character Development

Exclusive growth system for ​​Main Heroine: Asakura Touru​​

​​Full Version Features (Not in Demo)​​

​​Worlds 4-6​​ storyline and quests

Expanded customization:

More heroine outfits

Advanced equipment mechanics

New interactive systems (e.g., "Dynamic Touch" mode mentioned in

1)

Introduction of ​​two or more new heroines​​ with unique storylines and growth paths

An exhilarating idle loot-based 3D infinite flow game where you adventure with beautiful waifus !

Idle Looting & Casual Progression

Players can freely traverse worlds built from infinite flow worlds—novel realms, movie settings, game universes, and more!

Engage in manual combat or choose idle battles!

In idle mode, simply sit back and wait to obtain high-tier gear and rare materials.

Fight through levels, collect equipment, pets, and skills scattered across different worlds, and strengthen your character through upgrades—pushing forward until the end of all realms!

Maidens' Realm & Bonding System

Encounter numerous magical maidens with distinct personalities in the vast multiverse—these companions will always assist you in auto-battle!

Unlock a wealth of outfits and skins for free, shareable among all your magical maidens!

Increase their affection levels, deepen your bonds, and interact with them intimately touch interactions !

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: win7/win10/win11
  • Processor: intel Core i5-6400 or AMD FX 8320
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: win10/win11
  • Processor: intel Core i7-7700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
